**Format:** Git, IDE and debugging tutorial during the usual lab slots. The November 9–10 holiday notes are self-study preparation; no class or attendance is scheduled on those holidays.

**Evaluation:** attendance only. The tutorial work is not graded; no graded submission.

## Purpose

We have learnt C. Practise using development tools to edit, run, track and debug a program.

## Tutorial

Follow the [W15 self-study notes](../weeks/w15.qmd#coding-tools-self-study):

- **Git:** record a version, make a small change, inspect the diff and commit it.
- **IDE:** open a C project in VS Code, navigate its files, compile and run it.
- **Debugging:** use GDB through VS Code to set a breakpoint, inspect variables and step through execution. Fix an incorrect result and rerun the tests.

Use a previous C lab for practice. Work at your own pace; the notes include videos and interactive learning resources.
